caption: The drawing depicts a single tall case clock, commonly known as a banjo clock, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The clock has a circular face at the top with black Roman numerals and two black hands for the hours and minutes. Surrounding the clock face is a gold-colored frame, and above it is a decorative finial in a reddish-brown color resembling wood. The case of the clock is elongated and tapers slightly toward the top, adorned with a vertical panel featuring a decorative floral motif in yellow, red, and green tones. The case is flanked by two thin, curved gold lines. The lower portion of the clock case is a rectangular base with a marbled pattern in shades of brown, cream, yellow, and green, featuring a central rectangular vignette with the words "CHRONOMETER / ECLIPSIAN / PATENTED" written on it. The clock is rendered in subdued colors, primarily earth tones, with detailed shading and highlights suggesting a polished wooden surface and gilded accents. There are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Wall Clock
